mapper.select:

1 = 1
AND n.notice_title LIKE '%' || #{notice.noticeTitle} || '%'
AND n.notice_type = #{notice.noticeType}

ORDER BY n.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_notice_read (user_id, notice_id, read_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{noticeId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
